description: This file contains helper functions and constants for testing runtime secrets management in an OpenClaw project, including configuration setup, environment snapshotting, and cache clearing.

methods.name: asConfig
methods.description: Casts a value to the OpenClawConfig type.

methods.name: loadAuthStoreWithProfiles
methods.description: Creates an AuthProfileStore object with provided profiles.

methods.name: createOpenAIFileRuntimeFixture
methods.description: Sets up a runtime fixture with secrets and auth profiles in a specified home directory.

methods.name: createOpenAIFileRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Generates an OpenClawConfig object with secrets loaded from a specified file.

methods.name: expectResolvedOpenAIRuntime
methods.description: Asserts that the OpenAI API key and profile are correctly loaded.

methods.name: beginSecretsRuntimeIsolationForTest
methods.description: Captures environment variables and modifies them for isolated testing.

methods.name: endSecretsRuntimeIsolationForTest
methods.description: Restores environment variables and clears caches after testing.
